title: Horsehair Raku Pottery Workshop
source_quote:
Horsehair Raku Pottery Workshop
Saturday, October 3, 2026
1:00 PM
3:00 PM

In this three-session workshop, led by artist Mae Spencer, you will learn the multistep process of creating beautiful horsehair Raku fired pottery.
evidence_sentence: The Buffalo Art Guild events page lists a three-session workshop on horsehair raku pottery led by Mae Spencer starting October 3, 2026.
